text:
maya (CS): Heads up — StrideCore renewal stuck on procurement. They will only process via PO to their Canadian entity. Contract currently invoices our US entity. Procurement says invoice entity must match. Also they're asking to push payment terms to Net45. Finance flagged revenue recognition impact. Need quick alignment so onboarding doesn't slip.

carlos (AE): FYI I offered a 6-month term at 8% off to keep them in the door while we sort billing, but procurement wants the 12-month renewal. They're pushing for consolidated invoicing to StrideCore Canada (GST: 98-7654321).

erin (Legal): If invoice entity changes we must add an addendum and re-run the signature flow. Net45 is acceptable but require finance signoff for recognition schedule. Draft amendment template below:

"Addendum: Seller agrees to invoice StrideCore Canada (GST: 98-7654321). Payment terms updated to Net45 from effective date of this addendum. All other contract terms remain unchanged."

ash (Onboarding): Practical note: our trainer availability is booked week of 2026-06-01. If payment doesn't clear by 2026-05-25 we will need to postpone kickoff to 2026-06-08. We can do a kickstart call earlier but no hands-on workshops until payment posts.

maya (CS): Can we accept PO + Doc attached to contract and keep the US invoice on our side while billing does an internal cross-charge? Any quick workaround?

acct-bot: New invoice proviso: IN-2026-9001 generated (Net30). Pending manual update to Net45 upon approval. Please tag finance for exception.

carlos (AE): Procurement emailed vendor code CA-STR-44 and said they'll push PO today. I'll request a CC fallback for one invoicing cycle.

erin (Legal): Carlos, when you get the PO forward it to me. I can prepare the addendum and approve immediate signing via eSign. Template will include the Canada GST and Net45 clause.

esign-bot: Envelope created: env-77b9. "StrideCore Renewal - 12mo" created by maya (CS). Pending: StrideCore Procurement, carlos (AE), maya (CS). Link: https://esign.example/env-77b9

maya (CS): Great — I'll let procurement know to attach PO to the envelope. Ash, please tentatively hold the trainer for 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-08 as backup.

ash (Onboarding): Tentative holds placed. Will confirm final slot after invoice posts.

carlos (AE): PO received — PO# CA-2026-5555. Forwarded to erin and uploaded to envelope.

esign-bot: PO uploaded to env-77b9 by carlos (AE).

erin (Legal): Reviewed and countersigned addendum. Maya please route signed addendum + PO to renewals@ and billing@ so finance can finalize Net45.

acct-bot: Invoice updated to Net45 after approval. New reference IN-2026-9001-01. Accounting note: apply revenue recognition per amended addendum. :white_check_mark:

carlos (AE): Signed — procurement completed DocSign. StrideCore confirmed kickoff for 2026-06-01 pending funds posting.

maya (CS): Thanks all. I'll send a short enablement survey during onboarding and capture any renewal feedback. Closing thread for now.
file_note: Renewal thread: PO to Canadian entity, Net30->Net45 request, addendum, DocSign envelope, onboarding date risk and trainer holds.
